name: wyrm
description: Read and operate a WYRM broker network (devices, values, history, actions, dataflows) as one of its gateway users.
long_description: Connects Claude to a WYRM user gateway. Claude logs in as the gateway user you enter here and can do only what that user's role allows: browse the node tree, read live values and history, and, after a dry run that you approve, write values, run actions, deploy dataflows and run checked plans. Two local switches narrow it further: read-only, and config-level changes (off by default). The password is kept in the system keychain by Claude Desktop and sent only to the gateway.

gateway_url.title: Gateway URL
gateway_url.description: https://<broker host>:<port> of the WYRM gateway, or http://127.0.0.1:<port> for a gateway on this computer (plain HTTP is refused anywhere else).

user.title: Gateway user
user.description: The gateway user Claude works as. A user of its own (for example `claude` with the operator role) keeps Claude's changes apart in the audit.

password.title: Password
password.description: That user's password. Kept in the system keychain.

gateway_ca.title: Gateway CA certificate (optional)
gateway_ca.description: PEM file that signs the gateway's TLS certificate (the broker CA, or the certificate itself when it is self-signed). Leave empty for a certificate from a public CA.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Refuse every change, whatever the user's role allows.

allow_config.title: Allow config-level changes
allow_config.description: Let Claude make config-level changes (config points and actions, anything under sys, dataflow deploys) when the user's role allows them. Off: Claude can only show them.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: The gateway user, roles, grants, site and the connector's settings

tools.name: node_meta
tools.description: Full ~meta of a node: type, unit, writable level, actions

tools.name: value_watch
tools.description: Samples of a key or pattern over a few seconds

tools.name: history
tools.description: Recorded values and rollups of a point

tools.name: plan_run
tools.description: Check or apply a plan of steps
